source_text:
The old question hadn't disappeared.
What was the point of caring for
someone I couldn't keep safe? I still
couldn't say whether I'd done enough
for Blacky, Oreo, and Pie. Perhaps I
never could. But I knew they had
existed. I knew I had loved them. And
I knew the dog in front of me was
hungry now.
